summary: Capability tags the vehicle provides; must be a superset of any task it serves.
range: Array of non-negative integers; may be empty (then it can only serve tasks with empty skills).
businessRules: A task is assignable to this vehicle iff task.skills is a subset of vehicle.skills.
A single high-skill vehicle can become a bottleneck under load.

skills defines: It is a multi-dimensional object that can be used to define multiple skills and abilities of drivers or vehicles. Please note that only those vehicles with all the skills needed for a job/shipment …
Each element in skills must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: jobs.skills, shipments.skills. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Vehicle must have all skills required by the job (exact match, case-sensitive).
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
Skills matching is case-sensitive and exact. Vehicle must have ALL skills required by job.
testingGuidance: Positive: vehicle skills [1,2] serves a job needing [2].
Infeasible: no vehicle has the required skill -> job unassigned (skill reason).
Boundary: empty vehicle skills can serve only empty-skill jobs.
Interaction: Infeasible: job needs skill 3, no vehicle has 3 -> unassigned.
Interaction: Positive: job needs [2]; only the vehicle whose skills include 2 serves it.
